about: Where data/tzdata.json is expected to differ from the JavaScript runtime's own zone rules, keyed by the runtime's tz version (process.versions.tz). Each entry is a zone, the UTC date range in which differences are allowed (until null = open-ended), and the release note that explains it. A runtime on the same tz version as the data file must show no differences at all.
